heading: Control Structures
title: Control Structures
description: Conditional statements and loops in Python

dataList.data: Control structures allow you to control the flow of execution in your program. This includes conditional statements (if-else) and loops (for and while).

# Iterating over a list
fruits = ['apple', 'banana', 'cherry']
for fruit in fruits:
    print(fruit)

# Using range()
for i in range(5):
    print(i)  # 0, 1, 2, 3, 4
Loops are used to execute a block of code repeatedly. For loops are great for iterating over sequences, while while loops continue as long as a condition is true.
